'll try to keep it short. Also, please note that I am really not a conspiracy aficionado (although this is not to offend those who are).

So, there is this one food place that opened recently in Moscow, Russia, and it has quickly become huge. The place is like a food court, but the food is all hand made (if that makes sense), and it features various cuisines from around the world.

Now, Moscow has only recently started getting its taste for good handcrafted meals. There have always been cafes, and restaurants etc, but the food was always average and everyone was okay with that, including me; it rarely matched the quality of other countries and was pretty far from tickling your buds.

This new place has around 20 stands or so where you pay for your food and they prepare it right in front of you from scratch to a full meal. I mean if you order a shawarma there, a person from Turkey will make it for you by rolling dough, cooking it, cutting meat etc. It is said that the top niche cooks of Moscow who are passionate about food have gathered together and decided to open the place and set a new standard for what you eat.

And I have to tell you, the meals there are fantastic. I salivate just typing this. I've been around the world some, and I am honestly shocked/surprised that this place to me is the second best I have ever been to (number one is a small place in France, but that's a different story). I never expected anything like this to happen in Moscow, where food has usually been a matter of sustenance and not much more than that.

The prices there are above average Moscow prices, but not sky-high.

Now, I've eaten there maybe five times at this point (with my gf), and it's always a culinary orgasm.

BUT EVERY time we walk out of there, we find ourselves thirsty beyond belief. Like we just finished half a marathon or smth. The kind of thirsty where on our way home my gf couldn't wait 15 minutes till we get home and we had to run to the closest shop to get a bottle of water and gobble it down. It's this kind of thirst where you drink water until you are out of breath and then some more. You get the idea. (This does not happen when we eat at other places or at home, just this one place).

Now, my question is -- what the hell? Do they spike the food there with loads and loads of glutamate or smth? Is this possible? Did they all get together at some point and decided to cut the road to success and just make your regular food and load it up with some flavor enhancers?

Sorry for the long post, but I am really really curious to know, and that thirst really puts a damper on the whole experience and it'd be interesting to find out what's going on.

TLDR: new food place that's all the rage with incredible food feels really shady. Please weigh in, especially of you have the expertise.
